acceptance: Measured power iterations execute stream 00's ordering and parameters
Row-count validation runs on measured power iterations under the default validation mode
Tests assert the stream id and validation state of every measured iteration
context: 2026-10-04 throughput adversarial review (develop 8ed0c64e1). Reproduced by reviewer script.
description:
`tpch/platform_power.py:130-142` sets the measurement stream to warm-up count + i, i.e. streams 1, 2, 3. `power_test.py:183-190` turns validation off for any non-zero stream when no mode is set, and the CLI maps the default "exact" mode to None (cli/commands/run.py:668). The configured `stream_id` is printed but ignored.

Effect: the scored Power@Size runs use orderings from streams 1-3 instead of stream 00 as the spec requires, and are never row-count validated; only the warm-up is checked. Throughput streams then reuse those same orderings (throughput stream 0 = power permutation, see tpch-tpcds-throughput-stream-numbering).
